text: You can cancel Albert Genius in the app by opening the **Genius** tab, going to your Genius settings, and selecting **Cancel Genius**, then following the prompts to confirm. Menu names may vary slightly depending on your app version. If you can't find the option, contact Albert support through the in-app chat and they can cancel it for you. Also check that you receive a cancellation confirmation, and note that any Genius benefits will end once your cancellation takes effect.
